_doc: Entry inventory of the iPhone app (project rule 'every view has a visible door', docs/design/2.0.1/drilldown/README.md section 9). One entry per case of the destination enums below: where it is opened from (root = the first screen of a tab, or 'member' = the read-only page of someone else), how many taps from there, and the kind of door (tap = a visible control, gesture = a long press, swipe or drag that may only repeat a visible door). Watch2WhoopTests/ReachabilityTests.swift fails when a case has no entry, no tap door within 2 taps, or an entry names a case that no longer exists. A pull request that adds, moves or removes a screen updates this file in the same change.

LevelRoute.day.door: the dial (恢复 ›), the depth ladder, the 关注 / 体征 face (at 需要注意 / 体征)
swipe up on the first glance

LevelRoute.all.door: the bars, the depth ladder, the 周报 face (报告)
swipe up on the first glance

LevelRoute.metric.door: the 睡眠 / 负荷 reading (›)
dial → any row of 今日详情 (31 metrics), 需要注意, 体征, 今日核心
the hero's label (平均恢复 › and the other two scores), the 心肺 / 身体年龄 face
bars → any row of 指标

LevelRoute.night.door: bars → 睡眠 → a night (3), or the 平均睡眠 hero → 整晚 (2)

TodaySheet.weight.door: dial → ＋ on the 体重 row (记体重)

TodaySheet.reminders.door: dial → 提醒 chip; one reminder opens in place in the list

TodaySheet.status.door: dial → a 当前状态 card

TodaySheet.explain.door: 睡眠 reading → 需求 / 深睡 / 规律性 row; dial → a 身体状态 card

TodaySheet.load.door: 负荷 reading → 训练状态 row (CTL, ATL, TSB)

TodaySheet.detail.door: the empty dial's step (sleep help); dial → 今晚 chip (2)

TodaySheet.recovery.door: the recovery ring of someone else's 今天

TodaySheet.strain.door: the strain ring of someone else's 今天

TodaySheet.coach.door: the strain target card (今日核心) of someone else's 今天

TodaySheet.monitor.door: the 健康监测 card of someone else's 今天

TodayDetail.bedtimeGoal.door: 睡眠 reading → 入睡目标 row; also 我 → 入睡目标

TodayDetail.lab.door: dial → a 身体状态 card with a lab value; also 我 → 健康档案 → 化验

TrendsSheet.calendar.door: range menu → 选择结束日期

TrendsSheet.status.door: bars → a 当前状态 card

TrendsSheet.explain.door: 周报 face → a row of the report

TrendsSheet.recovery.door: the recovery card's title in someone else's 身体

TrendsSheet.regularity.door: the sleep regularity card's title in someone else's 身体

TrendsSheet.bodyAge.door: the body age card's title in someone else's 身体 (as its explanation)
